meta.method: Terrarium elevation tiles (z12) → 500 m block-average → slope/roughness/variogram; NASA POWER climatology; OpenAlex literature counts; solar geometry (NOAA-style).

target.name: Mars mid-latitude base (Jezero / NE Syrtis)
target.source: Target bands from published Mars mid-latitude statistics (MOLA topography; THEMIS/Diviner thermal summaries; PDS). Values are documented ranges, not a single mission measurement.

sensitivity.note: Weights perturbed ±20% (single and paired); ranking recomputed from the same dimension scores. Experimental, not a full uncertainty propagation.
